properties.name: railway.user.jwt.secret
properties.description: UTF-8 secret used to sign user JWTs. Must contain at least 32 bytes.

properties.name: railway.user.jwt.expiration
properties.description: Lifetime of a generated user JWT.

properties.name: railway.user.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Expected issuer written to and verified from user JWTs.

properties.name: railway.user.jwt.header-name
properties.description: HTTP request header carrying the user JWT.

properties.name: railway.user.jwt.token-prefix
properties.description: Optional prefix removed before JWT parsing.
